topic: How do GEO and LEO constellations trade off coverage area versus latency in 5G NTN architectures?
response: GEO constellations trade off coverage area for higher latency due to their large distance (36,000 km) introducing minimum one-way latency of 238 ms. In contrast, LEO constellations offer reduced propagation delays and can provide global coverage with lower latency (down to 2 ms).
reference_context: The context highlights the trade-off between coverage area and latency in 5G NTN architectures, emphasizing GEO's high latency due to its large distance from Earth and LEO's potential for low-latency communication.
